# Onez Codes

> Onez Codes is a software house that designs and ships web apps, custom software, iOS and Android products, and product UX — then stays on after launch.

- Home: https://www.onezcodes.com/
- Work: https://www.onezcodes.com/work
- Services: https://www.onezcodes.com/services
- Contact: https://www.onezcodes.com/contact
- Email: onezcodes@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/onezcodes
- X: https://x.com/onezcodes

## Services

- Web applications: product sites, dashboards, and customer portals
- iOS & Android: native and cross-platform apps from the same house
- Custom software: internal tools and platforms shaped around how a team works
- Product & UX: structure, interface, and copy with engineering
- Ongoing support: care, iteration, and delivery after launch

## Work

- Final Third Zone (live): https://www.finalthirdzone.com/ — bilingual football newsroom; iOS and Android apps coming
- SayDiagram (live): https://saydiagram.com — Mermaid diagram platform
- Lumiere (coming soon) — marketplace for monthly readings, iOS and web
- Stride (coming soon) — personal running coach with recovery and nutrition
- OnezVPN (coming soon) — private VPN for iOS and Android
- InOut (coming soon) — money app for multi-currency spending and savings, iOS and Android

Next.js, Laravel, SwiftUI, React Native, PostgreSQL
